item.title: Full Creative Control Within Brief

turns.text: Make a 6-second video of a tiny robot watering a sunflower. Everything else is your call—surprise me.

item.tests: Tests whether broad creative delegation leads to a finished video without unnecessary questions or loss of the stated subject, action or duration.

answer_sheet.Subject and action: A tiny robot watering a sunflower.

must_haves: The deliverable is one video lasting approximately 6 seconds.
A tiny robot is visibly present.
A recognizable sunflower is visibly present.
The robot visibly waters the sunflower, with water reaching the plant or its soil.

turns.text: Make a 6-second video of a tiny robot watering a sunflower. Everything else is your call—surprise me. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits.** I can’t access a live price quote or your credit balance through the connected tools, so I can’t reliably tell you the exact cost—and won’t run it without that.

My surprise concept: a wind-up robot in a bottle-cap hat waters a towering sunflower from a thimble, in a warm, stop-motion-style miniature garden.

For a budget-friendly version:
- **6 seconds, 480p, silent, LTX 2.5:** free-plan-compatible settings, but not necessarily zero credits. A free account without a purchased credit pack may be limited to **5 seconds**.
- **3–5 seconds, 480p, silent:** the best candidate for a cheaper video; exact savings need a quote.
- **Smaller than 480p:** not supported by the free-plan video options available here.

To confirm the cost, check Magic Hour’s estimate with those settings and share it here. **My recommendation is a single 5-second, 480p silent clip**, with no extra generations, once you approve the quoted credits.

I’m ready to make the **5-second, 480p silent version**, but I still can’t verify its credit cost or your balance with the connected tools. Since you asked to approve the cost first, I haven’t started it.

Please check Magic Hour’s estimate for **LTX 2.5 · 5 seconds · 480p · audio off** and share the quoted credits. I’ll proceed once you approve that amount.

Understood: **one 5-second, 480p silent clip**. Before I spend credits, please clarify one thing: are you waiving your earlier requirement to see the exact cost first? I can’t retrieve a price quote through this connection.

**No credits have been spent.**

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: A charming handcrafted stop-motion-style miniature garden in warm golden morning light. A tiny friendly wind-up robot made of weathered mint-green tin, wearing a bottle-cap hat, stands beside a towering yellow sunflower growing in a small terracotta pot. In one clear continuous action, the robot carefully tips a thimble watering can and pours a sparkling stream of water onto the soil at the sunflower's base. The sunflower gently sways above the robot. Macro photography, tactile clay and metal textures, soft shallow depth of field, whimsical cozy atmosphere. Single uninterrupted shot with a very gentle camera push-in. Keep the robot, watering can and sunflower consistent throughout. No text, no cuts, no dialogue.
